xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2528: Harness picker offers ohmypi for Anthropic+subscription combos it will reject at spawn (ToS)

plan.title: Harness picker offers ohmypi for Anthropic+subscription combos it will reject at spawn (ToS)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: The ohmypi + Anthropic-model + Claude-Code-subscription combination is forbidden by Claude Code subscription Terms of Service and is enforced only server-side at spawn time. No picker prevents the choice up front, and the client-side awareness that is wired is silently broken: GET /api/settings/harness-policy (src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts:1043-1047) keys the decision 'pi' computed via canUseHarnessSync('pi', model, authMode), but every picker looks up the 'ohmypi' key AND canUseHarnessSync('pi', ...) always returns ALLOWED (the ToS block lives only under harness==='ohmypi' in harness-policy.ts:86-92). So canUsePickerHarness('ohmypi', anthropicModel, policy) is always {allowed:true} and the auto-flip / 'ToS gated' branches never fire. Users can pick ohmypi for an Anthropic model under subscription in the pickers and get no visible feedback, or reach spawn and get a silent claude-code fallback with no explanation.
narratives.Proposal: First fix the data contract: key the harness-policy decision 'ohmypi' and compute it with canUseHarnessSync('ohmypi', ...), extracting a pure testable helper. Then make each harness picker render a blocked ohmypi option as visibly disabled with an inline reason (not a hover-only title / silent auto-flip): chat/ModelPicker.tsx's harness section and the shared HarnessSelect. Reword the ToS block reason to plainly name a Claude Code subscription Terms of Service restriction (backend string surfaced via the API; frontend constant kept in sync). Document the up-front behavior in configuration/harnesses.mdx. Keep the spawn.ts server-side canUseHarnessSync check as defense-in-depth.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT weaken or change the semantics of canUseHarnessSync (the ToS gate) or remove the server-side spawn.ts check (defense-in-depth for the CLI --harness flag).
- Do NOT restrict OpenAI/GPT models to claude-code; codex remains the intended default harness for GPT models and is unaffected.
- Do NOT change PlanDialog.tsx code: post-PAN-1984 ModelHarnessPicker renders no harness selector and PlanDialog already shows an inline reason (:874-876) and falls back to claude-code (:200); its message improves automatically when the reason copy is reworded.
- Do NOT change the chat picker model-list locking (it already disables locked models via pickerOptionLocked + Lock icon; Anthropic models under subscription default to the claude-code harness so they are never locked there).
- Do NOT introduce a new policy or new blocked combinations.

autoDecisions.summary: Root cause is the harness-policy API emitting key 'pi' (always-allowed) instead of 'ohmypi'; fix the data first — the UI changes are inert without it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified at code level: canUsePickerHarness('ohmypi', …) reads decisions[model]['ohmypi'] which is undefined today, so it always returns {allowed:true}. This is bug-fixing the wiring the issue points to ('reuse the existing decision data'), not a new policy.

autoDecisions.summary: Blocked harness options become disabled with a visible inline reason, replacing the prior auto-flip-the-model behavior (PAN-1067).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly requires 'visibly disabled or hidden, not just a no-op click' and a visible (not hover-only) explanation. Disabling rather than hiding keeps the option discoverable so the user learns why it is unavailable.

Post-PAN-1984 it renders no harness selector (ModelHarnessPicker shows only the model) and already renders an inline reason and falls effectivePlanningHarness back to claude-code; the reworded reason copy flows through automatically.

autoDecisions.summary: The user-visible reason is the backend OHMYPI_ANTHROPIC_SUBSCRIPTION_BLOCK.reason surfaced via the API; the frontend PI_TOS_BLOCK_REASON constant is kept in sync but is test-only today.
autoDecisions.rationale: canUsePickerHarness reads the reason out of the API response, not the frontend constant; rewording only the constant would not change what users see.

items.title: Fix /api/settings/harness-policy to emit the 'ohmypi' decision key

expected_outputs: settings-harness-policy test passes and asserts decisions[model].ohmypi.allowed === false for an Anthropic model under subscription auth

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts (decision map at ~:1043-1047), replace the `pi: canUseHarnessSync('pi', model, authMode)` entry with `ohmypi: canUseHarnessSync('ohmypi', model, authMode)` so the returned key and evaluated harness both match what the pickers query. Extract the per-model decision-building loop into a pure exported helper — e.g. `buildHarnessPolicyDecisions(models, resolveAuthMode)` — that accepts an injected async auth-mode resolver, so it is unit-testable without a live Effect HTTP server. The route calls the helper with getProviderAuthMode. Add a unit test that stubs the resolver to return 'subscription' for the Anthropic provider and asserts the ohmypi decision is blocked. Note: 'pi' is no longer a member of RuntimeName ('claude-code' | 'ohmypi' | 'codex'), so passing 'ohmypi' is also the type-correct value; drop any 'pi' key/cast (no picker consumes it).
